fields.summary_ko.0: Eli Lilly (NYSE: LLY) expands oncology research platform through Calytrix Bio acquisition adding rare blood cancer programs and collaboration with Stipple Bio on precision solid tumor therapeutics.
fields.summary_ko.1: Strategy leverages GLP-1 cardio-metabolic business-generated revenue to invest in next-generation growth drivers including oncology and neuroscience, progressing toward fair value target of $1,463.
